title: Easy DIY Hobo Bag + Free Pattern 🧵 Laila Bag Urban Outfitters Inspiration
description:
The perfect everyday bag! 🧵 In this video, I’m showing you how to sew a trendy Hobo Bag inspired by the Urban Outfitters Laila Bag.
✨ Full Step-by-Step Tutorial + FREE PATTERN is already on my channel!
Watch it here: https://youtu.be/0U9rFCUm0x0

❤️ My Instagram https://instagram.com/tatiana_diy
•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•♥•
✂️ Materials I used:✂️
🔹Canvas (Heavyweight fabric for the exterior)
🔹Thick Fusible Fleece Interfacing (180g for structure and shape)
🔹Cotton Lining (Soft interior fabric)
🔹Metal Buckle (~4.5 cm / 1.75 inches)
🔹Sew-on Magnetic Snap Fastener (or Sew-on Snap Button)
🔹Nylon Zipper (approx. 25-28 cm / 10-11 inches)
